description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2024: O.H. Hinsdale Wave Research Laboratory is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Pedro Lomonaco, Oregon State University (oregonstate.edu). The Hinsdale Wave Research Laboratory (HWRL is an experimental facility conducting fundamental and applied research in coastal and ocean engineering and science via physical model experiments. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file (PPTX). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-zvfc-a420. Keywords: O.H. Hinsdale Wave Research Laboratory; Wave Flume; Directional Wave Basin; Shared-use facility; Wave-structure interaction; Sediment transport and scour; Nearshore hydrodynamics; Wave breaking and impact; Hybrid simulation; Tsunami engineering; Coastal structures; Effects of Sea level Rise; Waterborne debris; Inundation of urban communities; Nature–based Solutions;  Extreme wave loads and forces. Published 2024-09-10. Facility named: Large Wave Flume and Directional Wave Basin - Oregon State University. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
